title: Ticwatch Atlas Button is unsafe!
body:
I had a few issues this last week or so with a new watch that I got to upgrade due to me needing too. But found that I already suspected might cause issues, that the large button on the side where it can be turned is doing this which me being aware of it.

And could have the potential to bolus me by its mistakes and me not being aware of it.

The watch also called Emergency service without be being aware too, so I tuen some settings off  one being the sos on  it and the other using night mode to keep the screen off so It was not accifddently pressed by me.

But today I also noticed when I went to bolus from the watch to a Dash pod it was doing the insulin dose on its own and took me a while to realize it was the button at first I thought it was the strap causing it some how to do it or the screen but then realized it was this button catching on the side of me.

On some Ticwatch pro reviews, I saw about this button mentioned and they said it was never an issue or it being pressed in by mistake,  which is correct no issues with the button getting pressed in but there is issues with the turning of these buttons and there needs ways to somehow to get it disabled or ways to change it to make safer.

I will attach a video so you can see what it is doing, and hope can be changed as the watch itself is a brilliant watch! and the batteries on it are also very good too.

[Ticwatch Pro Atlas watch](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/aEbBfLgFY-A)

comments.body: You can add a warning to the documentation
